title: Ranges are entered by their end and the last range has no end
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, one range.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Click Add Range.
  5. Type 25 as the first range's end.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • The single range reads from $0.00 and up.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • A new range is added before the last one; there are now two ranges.

Step 5:

  • The first range reads $0.00 to 25.
  • The next range starts at $25.01 ($25.00 + $0.01).
  • The last range has no end box, reads "and up" and has no delete button.
